title: Q-RULE-front-end-matches-back-end-claimcode: standing rule front-end-matches-back-end violated (claimcode)
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every lane pass (rules --run --due)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation claimcode --check
**Status:** closed

RULES-1: the standing rule `front-end-matches-back-end` is violated: Words match code: every public statement is bound to a probe of the running code (CLAIMS-1, WORDS-MATCH-CODE-1).
Probe `claimcode` says: claimcode: 1 problems

Fix the cause in code so the probe passes; the tick re-runs it every pass. Never weaken the probe or the registry.

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-27T05:08:33Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-27T11:02:41Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
